Good to know.

Why aren’t prices on the website?

Every service is tailored to your hair, skin and occasion. Message us and we’ll share current prices and the best option for you.

When should I book my bridal package?

As early as you can, especially in wedding season. A trial two to three months ahead gives us time to plan every look and prep your skin.

Can I book with friends or family?

Yes. Girls’ Day and bridal squad bookings are made for groups. Send us the number of people and your date.
